wizard.title: Welcome to ScreenPilot
wizard.welcome.title: Capture, annotate and document
wizard.welcome.body: ScreenPilot takes precise screenshots of regions, windows and monitors, and turns them into documentation. It runs quietly in the system tray and never sends data anywhere.
wizard.language.title: Choose your language
wizard.language.body: You can change it at any time in Settings. No restart needed.
wizard.hotkeys.title: Your shortcuts
wizard.hotkeys.body: These work everywhere in Windows. You can change them in Settings › Hotkeys.
wizard.workflow.title: How it works
wizard.workflow.body:
1. Press {hotkey}.
2. Drag over the area you need, or click a window.
3. Press Enter. The capture is saved and copied to the clipboard, ready to paste into Word, Outlook or Teams.

Right-click the tray icon for all options.
